rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who knows their stuff, especially in practical or subject-specific contexts.

example.english: This repairman is really knowledgeable; he can tell what is wrong with an old camera at a glance.
example.traditional: 呢個師傅好識嘢，部老相機有咩問題一睇就知。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si1 fu2 hou2 sik1 je5 bou6 lou5 soeng2 gei1 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1

rows.note: Use this for someone broadly well-educated, learned, or knowledgeable rather than highlighting practical expertise.

example.english: They have always loved reading and are really knowledgeable.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都鍾意讀書，真係好有學識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 zung1 ji3 duk6 syu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hok6 sik1

rows.note: Use this when saying that someone is knowledgeable about a particular subject, field, or topic.

example.english: I am very knowledgeable about the restaurants in this area, so I will take you somewhere good to eat.
example.traditional: 我對呢區嘅食肆好熟，帶你去食好嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ne1 keoi1 ge3 sik6 si3 hou2 suk6 daai2 nei5 heoi3 sik6 hou2 je5
